findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "outbound" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: audit_copy, sequence_planner, subject_line_scorer, utm_builder · Public sink: audit_copy, sequence_planner, subject_line_scorer, utm_builder · Destructive: subject_line_scorer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: audit_copy, sequence_planner, subject_line_scorer, utm_builder · Public sink: audit_copy, sequence_planner, subject_line_scorer, utm_builder · Destructive: subject_line_scorer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
